_rule: Written and committed BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). Observable: the intrusive shadow on the speaking characters at the held dialogue shot. Character ROI = G-buffer pixels of skin and hair class (RT2.a class bits of the trace; Hair/Scalp/Pubes class 5) in the shot's trace. A shot 'removes' the shadow when the ROI mean of the scene colour before post (dumps.json pass fs 5c3fdabc, 0.2126 r + 0.7152 g + 0.0722 b) rises above its OFF neighbours by more than the spread of shot-off-a..e in that ROI AND the shadow shape is gone in the PNG pair (ab_compare.py diff). 'keeps' = within the OFF spread. Whole-frame energy: every toggle except nosun and nohold only removes occlusion, so ON >= OFF - spread; a darker ON is a defect of the toggle, not attribution.

_hypotheses.H1: hair/scalp cards captured OPAQUE (rt_native_hair=0 in the user's session: stride 64) cast solid sun and local shadows on faces/necks
_hypotheses.H2: cinematic dialogue lights: D-LS now traces character-owned lights (ls_owners=31), art-unshadowed lights (ls_noshadow=1) and every box light (user ls_box=2), so rig lights the art leaves unshadowed get shadowed by the characters' own heads, hair and shoulders. ls_owners/ls_noshadow act only on lights joined to per-light data (rt_local_shadows.hlsl:153-158); unmatched lights and every box light are always traced, so 'nolocal removes, nobox/charlights/noart keep' = an unmatched (likely dialogue-spawned) point/spot light (ls_debug=9 red/cyan; ls stats 'matched %')
_hypotheses.H3: stale pose: the held absent draws (rt_dyn_hold=4, static camera) or the sun-only cascade soup of frame F-1/F-2 put an older pose of an animated character into the TLAS, offset from the real body
_hypotheses.H4: RT AO (gi_ao, 1 ray) darkening creases between hair and skin; contact shadows never run with rt_shadows=1 (core/gi.cpp:2816), so ruled out in Ultra
_hypotheses.H5: cascade casters: animated characters enter the sun TLAS twice (camera copy + cascade copy, opaque dedupe needs an equal per-draw UBO offset), the copy possibly another LOD and the hair DepthShadow FS 34951669 solid (not in the alpha table)
_hypotheses.H6: alpha-tested lashes/beards made opaque by a full alpha region: user session 0.00 per frame (); gated in every judged window, so if the run is valid H6 is excluded for these shots
_hypotheses.H7: wind-animated foliage (added 2026-11-02 after the user saw MOVING shadows in dialogue and none at the same spot in the isometric view): every camera-prepass draw is captured from its own VS output each frame, wind included (geocapture.cpp:5-11; wind VS never match the instancing pattern, spirv_xfb.h:312-320, so they are never cached: bvhsplit.cpp:29), so the RT sun sees the current wind pose of every tree the dialogue camera draws. The game's sun shadow comes from its own cascade passes (caster set, LOD and whether their VS applies wind not verified in code). The ground-level dialogue camera draws canopies the isometric camera does not, which would explain 'moving only in dialogue'. Off-screen trees come only from the cascade soup (F-1/F-2). The RT sun direction is the game's lighting direction from the camera UBO (rt_shadow.hlsl:80), so a dialogue light rig that changes the sun moves RT and lighting together; rt_debug=2 shows a mismatch with the game's own map. No key removes foliage casters only (no foliage/wind capture key in common/settings.h): the closest are rt_cascade_casters=0 (off-screen part) and rt_shadows=0 (all RT sun)
